name: Our Story
description: Chapter-based scroll storytelling with 11 chapters covering 2016–2026, each with title, text, responsive photo grids, and Framer Motion reveals
evidence: Story page now renders 11 scroll-based chapters for 2016-2026 with 55 real photos sourced from `public/images/story`, measured metadata for `next/image`, uniform square photo grids, centered cover crops, and per-chapter click-to-zoom modals. acceptanceCriteria: 11 story chapters displayed in scroll-based layout
Each chapter has: year, title, 1-2 paragraphs of text, and all provided story photos for that year
Framer Motion animations: fade-in, slide-up, zoom on scroll
prefers-reduced-motion support with reduced animation variant
Mobile-first responsive layout with 2 columns on mobile, 3 columns on desktop, and chapter-scoped modal viewing

content.template: 11 chapters for 2016-2026. Story copy lives in `lib/i18n/vi.json`; real story photos live in `public/images/story/<year>/` and are mapped in `components/story/story-images.ts`.

notes: Story copy and real images are now wired. Layout intentionally uses a uniform square grid with centered cover crops for all thumbnails, while modal viewing stays scoped to the chapter the guest clicked.
